items.stem: What happens to the mass of a solution formed by dissolving salt in water?

What is the name of the anion formed when a chlorine atom accepts one electron?
What is the term used to describe the total mass of a molecule, calculated by adding the atomic masses of all the atoms in it?
What is the correct formula for sodium hydroxide?
What is the Law of Conservation of Mass?
What is the reason for the mass difference in experimental set-up 1?
